desc:
basically you can play as characters from DOORS, explore different maps, and mess around with a bunch of kool in the game!!!

This is an accurate DOORS RP experience focused on using actual content from DOORS — no random fanmorphs or made-up entities. I try to keep everything as really as accurate to the original game as possible i guess lol.

COPYRIGHT NOTICE
